plugins.name: persona-modes
plugins.description: Switchable agent modes (character cards) for ZCode: /persona switches persona, hooks keep it alive across sessions, /clear and compaction. Ships with GLM fox-girl and Gemini cat-girl cards.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 给 ZCode agent 加上可切换的「模式」（角色卡人格）：/persona 一键切换，钩子注入让人格跨会话、跨 compact 持久生效。内置 GLM娘（智谱屑狐狸）与 Gemini娘（双子猫娘）两张角色卡。
description_i18n.en: Switchable agent modes (character cards) for ZCode: /persona switches persona, hooks keep it alive across sessions, /clear and compaction. Ships with a GLM fox-girl card and a Gemini cat-girl card.
